newsitem.title: USA: Summit wins $800,000 in patent case.
newsitem.headline: Summit wins $800,000 in patent case.

text.p: Summit Technology Inc said on Thursday that Herbert Schwind GmbH & Co has agreed to pay it $800,000 as part of a judgment upholding Summit's contention that the patent for its ophthalmic laser system had been infringed.
Summit said a German court ruled that Herbert Schwind's ophthalmic excimer laser system infringed Summit's Azema system patent.
Summit said it also obtained a separate German judgment against Chiron Technolas that its ophthalmic excimer laser system infringes the same patent.
Summit did not disclose the size of the award, if any, in that case.
The laser systems are used for nearsightedness, farsightedness, astigmatism, as well as corneal irregularities caused by disease or injury.
